note: Fresh 4-day consistency block Thu–Sun — not a rebuild of missed week 5. Loads from 7 Sep hard data; leave tank. No BSS. MoveU L2 W3. Train off the site even if Arnold is offline.

sessions.title: Hinge + Upper Balance
sessions.goal: Open the 4-day block clean. Re-groove trap bar hinge, balanced push/pull, bilateral squat pattern.
sessions.success: Trap bar identical reps with free back. Upper work controlled. Leave 2–3 in the tank.
sessions.note: Last hard data still 7 Sep: trap 60×5×4 @6.5; incline 17.5; goblet 15; farmers 20. Week 5 likely missed — treat this as a fresh quality block, not a rebuild.
questions: Back under trap bar vs 7 Sep — freer, same, or still stiff/creaky?
Any unexpected joint noise worth noting?
Energy after day 1 of 4 — drained, about right, or still had room?

blocks.title: Warm-up
blocks.note: Back was stiff/creaky on 7 Sep — do not rush mobility.

items.name: Trap Bar build-up
items.focus: Brace. Push floor away. Glutes finish. Soft lower.

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exercises.prescription: 57.5–62.5 kg (open 60; nudge only if sets 1–2 identical and back free)
exercises.focus: Every rep identical. Leave 2–3 in the tank.
exercises.note: 7 Sep locked 60 across. Do not chase 15 Aug 70s on day 1 after a gap.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Cable Chop
exercises.focus: Tall posture. Ribs stacked. Rotate through trunk, not lumbar flop.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.prescription: 17.5 kg each hand (20 only if set 1 is easy and crisp)
exercises.focus: Full control. Soft landing. No bounce.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.focus: Pause at top. No shrug. Chest stays glued.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.focus: Depth you own. Knees track toes. Tall chest. No BSS.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.focus: Walk tall. Soft ribs. Grip finishes the set, not form collapse.

sessions.title: Pull + Posterior Chain
sessions.goal: Vertical pull, hinge variation, knee-friendly single-leg, anti-rotation. Complement Thursday — do not stack fatigue.
sessions.success: Clean pull-up sets. RDL quiet back. Reverse lunge shin-vertical and quiet knee.
sessions.note: 7 Sep: purple-band pull-ups 6/6/6 felt good. Prefer reverse lunge over goblet if warm-up check is clean.
questions: Pull-ups — band and best clean set?
Reverse lunge — quiet knee, or did you switch to goblet?
Back later today vs after Thursday — better, same, or tighter?

blocks.title: Warm-up
blocks.note: Open hips and upper back before pulling and reverse lunges.

items.name: Bodyweight Reverse Lunge check
items.focus: Front shin vertical. Any under-kneecap pinch → goblet later.

items.name: Dead hang practice
items.focus: Shoulders quiet. Ribs down. Build toward 60s long-term.

items.name: Pull-up prep
items.detail: 1–2 easy sets of 3–4 purple-band or scap work
items.focus: Same purple band as 7 Sep is fine. Clean only.

exercises.name: Pull-up or Assisted Pull-up
exercises.prescription: Purple band (or same assist as 7 Sep). Aim clean 5–8 — stop before form breaks
exercises.focus: Full hang to chin clear. No kipping.
exercises.note: 7 Sep: purple 6/6/6. Match or beat total clean reps. Note band colour.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Cable Press
exercises.focus: Glute on front knee side. No rib flare on press.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.focus: Soft knees. Hips back. Hamstrings load — not a low-back yank.
exercises.note: Lighter hinge day after yesterday's trap bar. Quality range only.

exercises.name: Cable Pallof Press
exercises.focus: Resist rotation. Exhale on press. Ribs stacked over pelvis.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.prescription: BW–12 kg DBs. Prefer reverse lunge if check clean; else switch to goblet 16–20 kg and note it
exercises.focus: Front shin vertical. Controlled knee to floor. No BSS.
exercises.note: Knee cleared. Still cue shin-vertical. Name variation in notes if you switch.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Farmer Carry
exercises.focus: Stay tall. Do not lean away from the load. Soft ribs.

sessions.success: Honest dip variation. Hip thrust actually loaded so glutes own it. Capacity without frying Sunday.
sessions.note: 7 Sep hip thrust 15 kg was underloaded — earn real tension today (BB 40–60 or heavy DBs).

Hip thrust load used — glutes owning it?

items.focus: Prep for hip thrust. Ribs down.

items.name: Empty Bar or Light Overhead Press feel
Dip support or box/bench dip prep
items.detail: 2 × 15–20 sec support or 1 easy prep set
items.focus: Shoulders packed. No dumping into the joint.

exercises.name: Dip or Bench Dip
exercises.prescription: BW, assisted, or feet-elevated bench dip as needed
exercises.focus: Controlled depth you own. No shoulder pinch. Name the variation in notes.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.focus: Hips square. Pull elbow to hip. Pause.

exercises.name: Barbell or Dumbbell Hip Thrust
exercises.prescription: Load it — BB 40–60 kg or DBs ~20+ kg each. 15 kg last time was too light
exercises.focus: Chin tucked. Ribs down. Full glute squeeze at top. No lumbar overextend.
exercises.note: Structural priority. Glutes should own the set.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Landmine or Cable Press
exercises.prescription: Moderate — same effort as a solid DB press set
exercises.focus: Front glute on. No rib flare. Press clean.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat or Step-up
exercises.prescription: Goblet 16–22 kg; or step-up BW–light DBs on low-moderate box
exercises.focus: Quiet knee. Controlled. Name variation in notes. No BSS.
exercises.note: Prefer step-up if you want single-leg without reverse-lunge fatigue from Friday.

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.focus: Walk tall. Soft ribs. Grip finishes clean.
